info.title: v2.ams.get_validation_report
info.description: Retrieve detailed information for a specific validation bill

get.description: Retrieve detailed information for a specific validation bill

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.description: ID referencing the campaign rule applied. (Ties to the campaign seller created).

parameters.description: Specifies the page number of data to return in the current call. Starting from 1. If data is more than one page, the page_no can be some entry to start next call.

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Number of records returned per page, the maximum limit is 500, and page_no * page_size must be <= 10000.

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

parameters.name: validation_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the billing entry.

parameters.name: validation_month
parameters.description: Billing month in the format YYYYMM (e.g., 202405).

parameters.name: verified_status
parameters.description: Verified Status. Applicable values: Valid Invalid

<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/ams/get_validation_report?access_token=access_token&attr_campaign_id=18071&campaign_source=ShopeeManaged&item_id=3702824955&item_name=item1&l1_category_id=104136&l2_category_id=241360&l3_category_id=404136&order_sn=CWTUQ80EF9&page_no=1&page_size=20&partner_id=partner_id&place_order_time_end=1756051199&place_order_time_start=1753459200&shop_id=shop_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp&validation_id=602516439202502&validation_month=202502&verified_status=Valid',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'GET',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;
